response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), diffs AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.region, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - ov.avg_count AS diff FROM order_counts oc CROSS JOIN overall ov), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(diff) AS region_avg_diff FROM diffs GROUP BY region) SELECT df.account_id, df.region, df.order_count, df.diff AS diff_from_overall_avg, df.diff - ra.region_avg_diff AS excess_over_region_avg FROM diffs df JOIN region_avg ra ON ra.region = df.region WHERE df.diff > ra.region_avg_diff ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
